caption:
You can't out-spend a bad offer.

This is the part nobody selling you software wants to say out loud. Ads are a multiplier, not a generator. They take whatever you already have and show it to more people, faster.

If what you're selling converts, spending more is the obvious move.
If it doesn't, spending more just buys you a bigger sample size of no.

So before the budget conversation, the real questions are: who exactly is this for, what are you promising them, and why should they pick you over the guy down the road?

Those answers have no dashboard. They're still the ones that decide everything.

Free 20-minute audit in bio. We look at the offer before we look at the ads.
